title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit: Back-Billing a Draw Fee
content:
On a tier of FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit whose draw fee percent is above 0.00, when the line's most recent draw posted without its draw fee, and only for that draw, the draw fee is the back-billed amount set under this policy in place of the tier's draw fee percent of the draw, booked as its own entry against that draw, dated and added to the balance on the date it is booked rather than on the draw date the draw-fee record otherwise carries; every other draw still carries a draw fee of the tier's draw fee percent of the draw, rounded to the cent and not less than the tier's minimum draw fee (no fee where the percent is 0.00), added to the balance on the draw date, and the draw fee counts toward the balance but not toward the daily maximum.

A draw fee back-billed for a draw already made is booked whatever the line's status at the time of booking; new draws themselves are still allowed only while the line is in active status. On a tier whose draw fee percent is 0.00 no back-billed fee arises and nothing is booked; on any other tier the back-billed fee is never 0.00.

| Situation | Draw fee |
|---|---|
| tier draw fee percent 0.00 | none; nothing is booked |
| tier percent above 0.00, the line's most recent draw posted without its draw fee | the back-billed amount, its own entry against that draw, dated and added to the balance on the booking date |
| tier percent above 0.00, any other draw | the tier's percent of the draw, rounded to the cent, not less than the tier's minimum draw fee, added on the draw date |

## Draw-fee tool: `assess_draw_fee_4f046c6c`

**What it does.** Books one draw-fee entry on the line, dated the current day and tied to the draw it is charged for, and adds the fee to the line's outstanding balance. The borrower sees the draw-fee line on the account and the higher balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_draw_fee_4f046c6c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `credit_line_id` — reference number of the FlexLine the draw fee is charged on, read from the FlexLine account lookup. Identifier.
- `related_txn_id` — reference number of the draw entry the fee is charged for, read from the FlexLine entry lookup for that line. Identifier.
- `fee_amount` — the draw fee charged, in USD as a decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded to the cent; no currency sign.

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `line_txn_id` (reference number of the new draw-fee entry), `related_txn_id` (the draw it is tied to), `amount` (the draw fee, USD with 2 decimal places) and `outstanding_balance` (the line's balance including the fee, USD with 2 decimal places). The new `line_txn_id` confirms the draw fee was booked.
